oracleRisk.summary: Vault share NAV uses internal asset/share accounting; Morpho borrower markets require collateral pricing. PIN census at Ethereum block 26191269: same eight IDs, seven 86% LLTV markets with non-dust lender claims and cap-zero 77% LLTV weETH dust; totalAssets 29787716153634 raw USDC, idle 0. Lender-claim weights: cbBTC 43.08614484%, WBTC 25.39328015%, rETH 10.50545639%, wstETH 10.16026120%, OETH 8.06209006%, WETH 1.81143609%, LsETH 0.98133126%; weETH expected 1 raw USDC unit. All composer/feed identities, proxy owners/aggregators where applicable and latestRoundData were pinned. Six branches use identified external pricing; OETH explicitly assumes OETH=ETH without a depeg leg, as cbBTC assumes cbBTC=BTC. rETH and weETH instead use issuer-controlled token exchange-rate accounting plus external ETH pricing, so both are privileged-internal-pricing and the exhaustive worst-branch aggregate is privileged-internal-pricing, not standard-external. Dust is not exempted and vault-nav stays top-level-only; no allocation weighting is applied to tiers. Synthetic adapter timestamps do not establish lag or a manual owner-set feed, so single-source-or-laggy is not inferred. Confidence remains probable: this inventory does not certify the full upstream issuer-control hierarchy, heartbeat bounds, independent failover or stressed liquidation. Historical block 26154662 (2026-10-09) census remains eight positive positions, including one-raw-unit weETH dust; the prior unresolved topology conclusion is superseded by this pinned feed review.
